description: This file defines the Customer entity class in a Java-based e-commerce system, mapping to the CUSTOMER database table. It manages customer-related data including personal details, associations with groups, reviews, delivery and billing addresses, and localization preferences.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer in the system, encapsulating personal details, preferences, and relationships with other entities such as reviews, groups, and addresses.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns a clone of the customer's date of birth.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the customer's date of birth.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getNick
methods.description: Returns the customer's nickname.

methods.name: setNick
methods.description: Sets the customer's nickname.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company associated with the customer.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company associated with the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the customer's password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the customer's password.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Checks if the customer is marked as anonymous.

methods.name: setAnonymous
methods.description: Sets the customer's anonymity status.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Returns the list of product reviews made by the customer.

methods.name: setReviews
methods.description: Sets the list of product reviews for the customer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the customer.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the customer.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery address information.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Gets the delivery address information.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing address details.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address details.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Sets the groups the customer belongs to.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with the customer.

methods.name: getShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Retrieves the transient display string for customer state list.

methods.name: setShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Sets the transient display string for customer state list.

methods.name: getShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Retrieves the transient billing state list display string.

methods.name: setShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Sets the transient billing state list display string.

methods.name: getShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Retrieves the transient delivery state list display string.

methods.name: setShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Sets the transient delivery state list display string.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language preference of the customer.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language preference.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the collection of customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of customer attributes.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the gender of the customer.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Retrieves the gender of the customer.
